ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Download - Powershell Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download command Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFileAsync\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadStringAsync\\(.*"))
